timeline.title: Lemon Tree jumps 7% after profit beat
timeline.line: Q2 profit rose 63.7% to ₹56.6 crore on revenue up 18% to ₹361 crore

Motilal Oswal and JM Financial kept their Buy ratings

dossier.headline: Lemon Tree jumps after a profit beat
dossier.summary: Lemon Tree Hotels shares rose as much as 7% on November 12 after Q2 FY27 profit rose 63.7% to ₹56.6 crore on revenue up 18% to ₹361 crore, beating estimates. About ₹22 crore of the profit came from a one-off gain on ending a hotel lease.
why_it_matters: Shows demand strength in the hotel sector going into the peak season
watch: How much of the margin gain repeats without the one-off item
questions: What is the underlying profit growth excluding the lease gain?
conflicts: The intraday gain was reported as 7% in one report and 4.36% at 10:32 am in another
